summary: Support requests go through your installation's own queue, and private-network installs check their network first.

fixes.title: Support requests arrive on your own queue
fixes.text: Support requests arrive on your installation's own queue.

fixes.title: Private-network installs check the network first
fixes.text: Before it creates anything, a private-network install checks everything it needs and lists everything missing at once, with what to create. Nothing is created until it is there.
